text:
Ana: Quick sync — we need to compress Hosted/Dedicated/Private pages into a single scaffold with mode-specific bullets. Goal: reduce hero copy to ~60-80 words.
Liam: +1. Can we keep separate CTAs? Try Hosted / Request Dedicated / Contact for Private.
Sofia: I’ll push a Figma pass by EOD, focusing hero microcopy + one-liners. Will add webinar CTA variants.
Matt: Benchmarks need a home on the page. Can we show a short callout: 99th %ile latency / cost per 1k tokens?
Ana: Use conservative placeholders for copy: Hosted ~50–100ms p50/p99 callout, Dedicated = predictable throughput/SLA, Private = self-managed. Link to /benchmarks.
Jamie: For inbound routing, recommend prefill + dropdown (deployment_mode) to map leads to Sales/SE/Webinar list.
Sofia: Noted. I'll add hidden fields: source=site, campaign=landing-copy-sprint, route=(dedicated|hosted|private).
Dev-bot: Deploy preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/landing-copy-1758889999 — automated build #482
Liam: A/B test idea: 'Predictable inference for production' vs 'Low-latency, low-cost inference' — which to run in hero?
Ana: Run both, wire to analytics, and set canary to 10% traffic for Dedicated pricing page.
Sofia: Uploading Figma now — will include copy variants + CTA rules. @Jamie ping me for form schema.
Jamie: Drafting form schema: fields = [use_case, company_size, deployment_mode, sla_need]. Will add HubSpot mapping.
Matt: I'll pull preliminary infra numbers from the infra team and craft 2-line benchmark blurbs. ETA tomorrow AM.
Ana: Owners: Sofia (copy + Figma), Jamie (form + routing), Matt (benchmarks), Liam (A/B + analytics). Sync Friday 10:00am PT.
Liam: Sounds good.
Sofia: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/landing-copy-sprint — pushing now.
Jamie: Webhook for HubSpot created, will share mapping in thread.
Dev-bot: Asana task created: https://app.asana.com/0/123/456/789 (Landing copy sprint)
Ana: Awesome — thanks everyone :rocket:
